author: espoirschooloflife
title: Hiring Storybook Illustrator (Paid Project)
content: WE ARE HIRING: STORYBOOK ILLUSTRATOR (Paid Project) Espoir School of Life is looking for a creative Storybook Illustrator who can capture the stories written about Espoir School of Life. The stories are already written, and we now need an artist to bring these local narratives, community impacts, and grassroots projects to life through vibrant illustrations. How to Apply: fill out our application form here: bit.ly/espoir-SI Be ready to share your Contact Information, Portfolio Link, Expected Rate/Project Quotation.
